questions.prompt: Jack bolts push a motor sideways on its mounting base. Which alignment plane do they adjust?
questions.explanation: Jack bolts move the motor sideways. Vertical corrections use shims.

questions.explanation: The motor rotates to change its angle. The slide shows one jack bolt tightening and the opposite location loosening to make the angular move.
